about: Halo 3's announcer, read from the player's MCC FMOD banks (halo3/fmod/pc/*.fsb + .fsb.info). Each 'match' entry is a line name searched anywhere in the .info source paths (case and slash direction ignored); paths under a multiplayer/announcer folder win over others. HaloBridge writes the full list of names to runtime/halo3_sound_index.txt.

columns.match: line names tried in order, searched anywhere in the source path

rows.rule: two kills less than 4 s apart (Halo's multi-kill window)
three kills chained within 4 s of each other
all four gauntlet kills without dying (the gauntlet's spree; Halo needs 5, the gauntlet has 4 fighters)
